identity_basis: sha256 of canonical JSON excluding id, identity_hash, and generated_at
title: Active Execution Index Reconciliation
goal: Make the read-first Lukspeed active-work surface match current merged and governed reality without changing product direction or opening implementation.

permitted_operations: read target-native governing sources and exact Git evidence required by this Mission
create or use a clean isolated target-repository lane after repository preflight
run read-only Context OS diagnostics using the exact published runtime and profile
validate and create one local docs-only commit in the isolated lane
prohibited_surfaces: web, backend, database, or data-plane implementation
providers, credentials, secrets, or environment configuration
prohibited_operations: modify, clean, stash, reset, rebase, or reuse the pre-existing active worktree
change product direction or invent a new priority
reopen closed work without exact current authority
access production, providers, secrets, or customer/rider records
overwrite or discard existing user work
push, create a PR, or perform another GitHub mutation without separate target-repository publication authority
use the Context OS repository identity for target operations

read: target-native canonical sources selected by the valid Activation Package
Git commit and merged-PR evidence required to verify active-state labels
write: docs/BACKLOG_PRIORIZADO.md in a clean isolated lane only
side_effects: one local docs-only commit may be prepared
no remote publication or merge without separate target authority

target_authority_mappings.purpose: roadmap orientation; active backlog wins on active-state conflict

checks: repository-bound Git identity resolves to LKSPDEV
current origin/main SHA is recorded before analysis
the execution lane is isolated and clean
the pre-existing active worktree is neither used nor modified
repository_preflight.on_mismatch: STOP with AUTHORITY_MISMATCH; do not switch identities automatically

must_bind: exact LKSPDEV/lukspeed repository state and origin/main SHA
exact Adoption Profile id, version, identity hash, and source
the exact fresh Activation Package and Handoff
context_version_requirements.continuity_rule: Missing or unresolved source evidence remains an explicit gap and is never reconstructed from current assumptions.

activation_requirements.goal: Make the read-first Lukspeed active-work surface match current merged and governed reality without changing product direction or opening implementation.
activation_requirements.selection_rule: Context OS selects bounded target-native governing context from the Goal, Mission, profile, and current target state; the operator does not manually nominate the governing file set.
activation_requirements.invalidation_rule: Any material target source, profile, repository identity, authority, package, Handoff, or Validator drift requires fresh generation before work continues.

constraints: Target canon remains authoritative; the Adoption Profile and Handoff are not target SSOT.
The Mission must run in a clean isolated Lukspeed lane created by the receiving project.
The active target worktree and all pre-existing user changes must be preserved exactly.
Only evidence-backed status reconciliation is allowed.
Unknown or conflicting active state must remain explicit and route to the Lukspeed Product Owner.
No Context OS or target repository identity may be reused across repository boundaries.
Stop before remote publication or merge unless separately authorized by Lukspeed authority.
success_criteria: The active index contains only open, queued, or ready work supported by current evidence.
Temporal drivetrain and recent catalog work have evidence-backed current status or are explicitly unresolved.
No new product priority is invented.
One next active execution lane is explicit or honestly unknown.
Only docs/BACKLOG_PRIORIZADO.md differs from the target base SHA.
The pre-existing active Lukspeed worktree remains untouched.
Context Version, Activation Package, and Handoff remain valid at verification.
kill_criteria: The required isolated clean lane cannot be established without touching active work.
Evidence conflicts require a product-owner decision.
Any path outside the permitted surface must change.
Any runtime, provider, production, secret, customer, or rider-data access is required.
The profile, Context Version, Activation Package, Handoff, or Validator gate is invalid.
The requested operation reaches remote publication or merge without separate target authority.
evidence_plan: Record exact target origin/main SHA and successful repository authority preflight.
Record isolated-lane creation and prove the pre-existing worktree was not used or modified.
Record exact Context OS runtime SHA and Adoption Profile binding.
Persist machine-readable Context Version, Activation Package, Package Check, Handoff, and Handoff Check evidence in the receiving Mission evidence surface.
Inventory active-index entries before and after reconciliation.
For every changed status, cite exact merged PR, commit, closure, or current canonical evidence.
Record unknown, contradictory, or owner-dependent states without resolving them by inference.
Record before/after hash for docs/BACKLOG_PRIORIZADO.md and prove zero diff outside that path.
Run applicable documentation validation and Context OS Validator gate under the target profile.
Record the local docs-only commit and stop state before publication or merge.

rollback_boundary.before_commit: Restore only the isolated lane copy of docs/BACKLOG_PRIORIZADO.md to the recorded base; do not touch any shared worktree.
rollback_boundary.after_local_commit: Revert the exact single docs-only commit or discard the isolated lane after preserving evidence.
rollback_boundary.after_remote_publication: Not authorized by this Handoff; requires separate target governance.
rollback_boundary.guarantee: Rollback must never remove or rewrite pre-existing user content.

handoff_boundary.eligibility_condition: The Lukspeed Codex project must independently pass repository preflight and produce valid fresh target-bound Context Version, Activation Package, and Handoff evidence.
